learnings.subject: projection methodology
learnings.statement: Regress short recent samples toward a longer season baseline unless there is concrete evidence of a durable role change.

learnings.subject: touchdowns
learnings.statement: Do not treat a long touchdown or short touchdown streak as repeatable volume; separate opportunity from realized scoring.

learnings.subject: wide receivers
learnings.statement: For pass catchers, consider role/alignment versus man-zone and coverage shells, likely primary coverage, pressure/QB interaction, and comparability of prior opponent/play-calling environments.

learnings.subject: running backs
learnings.statement: For running backs, distinguish raw recent production from sustainable workload, goal-line role, passing-down role, teammate competition, offensive-line context, box tendencies, and game-script sensitivity.

learnings.subject: market baseline
learnings.statement: Treat the app projection as an important benchmark and calibration anchor, not as the answer. Material disagreement should be traceable to explicit component assumptions.

learnings.subject: weather
learnings.statement: Weather is a cross-cutting modifier to underlying stat assumptions, not a blunt post-hoc fantasy-point adjustment.
